data.description:
Write tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh covering all key behaviors of plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh BEFORE the script exists (RED gate). Tests must cover:
1. Script exists check (fails until Task 2)
2. Detects open story/* PRs targeting main via gh pr list --json number,headRefName,baseRefName
3. PATCHes each PR base to the session branch via gh api PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}
4. Issues gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml --ref <story-branch> for each retargeted PR
5. Idempotent: PRs already targeting the session branch are skipped (no duplicate PATCH/workflow-run)
6. Clears/invalidates cached review-status for each migrated PR (e.g., deletes or resets the review-status artifact or cache marker for that PR)
7. Fails with non-zero exit + actionable error if resolve-session-branch.sh cannot resolve session branch
8. Uses GH_PR_LIST_OVERRIDE / GH_API_PATCH_OVERRIDE / GH_WORKFLOW_RUN_OVERRIDE env vars for test isolation (same pattern as resolve-session-branch.sh)

Use mock binaries in a TMPDIR for gh isolation. Follow the pattern in tests/scripts/test-resolve-session-branch.sh. All tests must FAIL until the implementation script exists (confirming RED state).
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for migrate-story-pr-bases.sh
